# Conviction Markets

Conviction Markets is a leveraged marketplace for prediction markets.

Traders use Conviction to find event markets, review market rules, and get more exposure with vault-backed margin.

Liquidity providers supply capital to Conviction vaults and earn yield from margin activity.

## Core pages

- Home: https://convictionmarkets.xyz/
- Markets: https://convictionmarkets.xyz/markets
- Margin desk: https://convictionmarkets.xyz/margin
- Activity and signals: https://convictionmarkets.xyz/social
- Docs: https://convictionmarkets.xyz/docs
- Leaderboard: https://convictionmarkets.xyz/leaderboard

- Short description: Leveraged prediction markets powered by vault liquidity.
- Trader description: Get more exposure to event markets with vault-backed margin.
- Liquidity provider description: Supply capital to vaults and earn yield from margin activity.
